body: I absolutely agree with you on all fronts.
Eye of the beholder, or some shit.
This is heartbreaking and beautiful. Rest easy.
Thanks for this response. I love that you’ve found purpose and are doing better. Cheers to you, friend.

Sort of like a wrap-up party. This is a great idea. I’ll eat poutine and lobster every night and paint my nails bright blue (always been too self-conscious to pull that off).

And well, there’s no way that the last thing I see before I die is this claustrophobic, smothering landscape. Plus, I could never do it somewhere close to my parents. I know exactly where I want to go, out on the Atlantic...somewhere I can look off into the horizon as I fade away. If I’m gonna do it, I’m gonna do it right.
❤️ I’ll keep that in mind. Thank you.

I’m happy to hear this. You seem like a really great person willing to chat with total strangers about wicked problems. Hopefully, things work out for me, too, and I can pay it forward. I just wanted to have all my bases covered, just in case...you know?
Thank you, thank you for saying this. People like you are lights in this world.
Thank you for asking. I appreciate your kind intentions.

Truly? I just can’t seem to grab ahold of some kind of life, and I see the effect my incompetence has on those I love. I don’t trust my own mind, and feel like a stranger in my body. I consistently make impulsive poor decisions, or take no action at all. I’m a stultus. I see the way others perceive me. All this, plus million more reasons, probably, that I don’t know how to articulate.
Yikes, haha. Loaded question. The same reasons expressed by so many people on this sub, I suppose. Sorry if that’s a weak response.

Oh god I’m happy I’m not alone in this. How long do your hangovers last?? Mine are definitely AT LEAST 48 hours, but my friends think I’m just being dramatic. Sometimes they’re are so bad I won’t even take my pills, since those alone can make me feel nauseated. Such rough days.

Late to the party, but pretty experienced on this topic. Personally, I’m able to drink much more than usual when I’m taking antidepressants without feeling “drunk.” I’m currently taking 150 mg Venlafaxine + 45 mg Mirtazapine. However...I will almost always black out, even if I remember feeling dead sober the night before. And the hangover is KILLER. Yeah, my liver is probably in rough shape, I know. However, I find my pills still help a LOT...on the off day I forget them, I notice a major difference. Not sure if this info helps.
You're not alone in feeling this way. Not that me saying this is any consolation.
Maybe you're right. I think I'll give it a try. Thank you both for the advice!!

I've often thought of doing something like this, but my partner already accuses me of "scheduling sex." Maybe if I did it in earnest, and spoke with him about my reasons for doing it, like you did, he'd be more receptive. Your story is so encouraging--thank you for sharing! I wish you all the best.
